description: This file implements peephole optimizations for non-tensor operations in the PyTorch JIT compiler, including simplifications of arithmetic nodes, conditional nodes, and type unwrapping.

classes.name: PeepholeOptimizeNonTensorImpl
classes.description: Implements the optimization logic for the peephole pass, including traversal and node simplification.

methods.name: checkArithNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is a binary integer arithmetic operation with a constant operand and returns that constant if available.

methods.name: trySimplifyMulOrDiv
methods.description: Simplifies multiplication or division nodes by 1.

methods.name: trySimplifyAddOrSub
methods.description: Simplifies addition or subtraction nodes by merging constants.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the optimization over the entire graph.

methods.name: optimizeBlock
methods.description: Recursively optimizes nodes within a block.
